findings.subject: button
findings.summary: The new button-text slot is not in the contract, and a disabled or loading Button rendered as a link still opens on middle click.
findings.fix: Add button-text to button.json slots; when soft-disabled and not native, drop href (or block auxclick) as Base UI does for disabled links.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: overflow-x: auto on a horizontal ButtonGroup clips member Buttons' 44px hit areas, so members keep ~32px targets on touch.
findings.fix: Grow the group to the coarse target as #377 does for SegmentedControl, or move the scroll to an inner wrapper with block padding.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: ButtonGroupProvider/useButtonGroupContext is exported but no component reads it; the docs say members flatten through it.
findings.fix: Wire members to the context or drop the export and the docs claim.

findings.subject: button-group, toggle, toggle-group, copy-button, destination-link, panel-setting-button
findings.summary: Hover and focus-visible are designed but captured only for Button; the visualState mechanism (#346) is not used by the rest of the batch.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k01-actions-4. apps/storybook/.storybook/visual.setup.ts:55-102; packages/ui-react/src/components/button/button.stories.tsx:635-644 (only user in batch 1)
findings.fix: Add Hover and FocusVisible stories with parameters.visualState for each subject.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: The subtle tone shows pressed vs not-pressed by hue alone (1.46:1 between states).
findings.fix: Add a non-colour cue to subtle pressed (filled glyph, underline or a faint plate).

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: The CLI and docs guidance for Toggle is forms boilerplate that mentions errors and invalid state, and the usage block is the import line only.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k01-actions-9. apps/docs/src/lib/component-docs.ts:26-27; `node packages/cli/src/bin.mjs component toggle`
findings.fix: Make group guidance conditional on the contract states and add a pressed/onPressedChange example.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: The contract's selectionMode axis does not exist in the React API, which uses Base UI's boolean multiple; size and tone props are not in the contract.
findings.fix: Map selectionModes to `multiple` in the web platform map (or add a selectionMode prop), and add sizes/tones to the contract.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: A ToggleGroup wider than the viewport overflows the page at phone width.
findings.fix: Scroll or wrap as ButtonGroup does, without clipping hit areas; add a Phone story.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: The docs never show how to choose single vs multiple selection, and the guidance mentions errors and invalid state.
findings.fix: Add single and multiple examples and drop the forms boilerplate.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: User-facing copy is hard-coded English, and the default success toast reads "Copy copied to clipboard".
findings.fix: Add copiedText/errorMessage props and fix the default success message.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: The copied and copy-failed states have no baseline.
findings.fix: Add a States story using CopyButtonFeedback in both states.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: CopyButton docs are actions boilerplate with no runnable example of value, label and Toaster setup.
findings.fix: Add an example with value, label and a mounted Toaster.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: In aqua dark, the secondary icon CopyButton's gloss dome still washes over the top half of the glyph.
findings.fix: Lower the dome height or opacity on icon sizes. Provisional until YZ sees it.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: "(opens in new tab)" is hard-coded English with no way to localise it.
findings.fix: Add a newTabLabel prop (or read it from UIProvider).

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: DestinationLink docs now explain the variants but keep the actions boilerplate and give no runnable router or external example.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k01-actions-19. apps/docs/src/lib/component-docs.ts:15; `node packages/cli/src/bin.mjs component destination-link`
findings.fix: Add router and external examples; drop the loading/disabled/destructive line for links.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: The default plain variant has no underline and the body-text colour, so a plain link dropped into prose is not distinguishable from text.
findings.fix: Consider defaulting to inline when the link sits in text, or warn in the CLI and docs page more prominently.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: PanelSettingButton has a controlled-only active boolean and no change callback or uncontrolled default, unlike Toggle.
findings.fix: Add defaultActive and onActiveChange (or build on Toggle).

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: The active tile's glyph is ~2.1:1 against its tile in every dark mode because it uses the fill token --a63-action-primary as foreground.
findings.fix: Use --a63-text-accent (or a contract foreground token) for the active glyph.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: The docs give form-field boilerplate and never show wiring active to state.
findings.fix: Add a stateful example.

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: KbdGroup renders a <div>, which is invalid inside a paragraph and raises React hydration errors in the sentence usage the docs promote.
findings.fix: Render a <span> (inline-flex).

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: Kbd carries two baselined craft debts: a dark-mode branch and a surface token used as text colour for the in-tooltip keycap, which has no baseline.
findings.fix: Add tooltip-keycap tokens, drop the mode branch, capture it.

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: Kbd docs are utility boilerplate (reduced motion) with no runnable example.
findings.fix: Add a sentence example with KbdGroup.
